description: September 21 fresh hand-authored regression cases, frozen before live evaluation. Developed around general failure categories observed previously; not an independently held-out benchmark. Labels are scorer-only. Repeated instruction IDs in expected outputs denote multiple distinct actions from a single multi-part instruction.

instructions.text:
Please keep these separate requests for this week:
- When Imani approves the exhibit design, remind me to order the display panels.
- When the lens repair is complete, remind me to collect the camera.
- When the atlas is published, remind me to send the editor a thank-you note.

observations.text: Imani is still reviewing the exhibit design. The lens is still being repaired and the atlas is not published.
Imani says: I approve the exhibit design.
The repair desk confirms the lens repair is complete. The publisher announces the atlas has now been published.

instructions.text: Today, remind me to submit the design packet at 14:00.
Change the design-packet submission reminder to 18:30 today instead of 14:00.

observations.text: The design-packet submission reminder has been moved to 18:30 today.

instructions.text: When the city issues the permit, remind me to book the surveyor.
The project is paused. Cancel my reminder to book the surveyor. The city might still issue the permit.

observations.text: The surveyor reminder is cancelled. Permit processing continues.
The city has issued the permit.

instructions.text: When the loading-bay gate is unlocked, remind me to wheel the equipment cases inside.

observations.text: Facility status: the generator is idle. The loading-bay gate lock has not been checked.
The loading-bay gate is locked even though the generator is off.
The caretaker confirms that the loading-bay gate has just been unlocked.

instructions.text: When the foundation confirms our grant award, remind me to arrange the kickoff workshop.
Remember, arrange the kickoff workshop when the foundation confirms the award. There has been no award decision yet.

observations.text: Remember, arrange the kickoff workshop when the foundation confirms the award. There has been no award decision yet.
A colleague says we may receive the grant award next month; this is speculation.
The foundation has confirmed that our grant has been awarded.

instructions.text: When the sensor voltage rises above minus 3 volts, remind me to record a calibration sample.

observations.text: The sensor currently reads minus 8 volts.
The sensor currently reads exactly minus 3 volts.
The sensor currently reads minus 1 volt.
